I have resolved the issue where proxy requests with authentication credentials resulted in HTTP 407 errors.

### Root Cause
When Requests moved to `urllib3.util.parse_url` in `prepend_scheme_if_needed`:
1. `parse_url` returns a `Url` tuple where `parsed.netloc` contains only `host:port` (or `host`), excluding the user/password authentication (`auth`) component. Reconstructing the URL with `parsed.netloc` was stripping the authentication credentials from proxy URLs (e.g. `http://user:pass@proxy:8080` became `http://proxy:8080`).
2. For scheme-less proxy URLs with credentials (e.g. `user:pass@proxy:8080`), `parse_url` interpreted `user` as the URL scheme, producing malformed URLs.
3. `get_auth_from_url` raised a `TypeError` when `password` was `None` (e.g. `http://user@proxy`), resulting in missing auth tuples.

### Solution
- Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-80sb6p1p/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-80sb6p1p/requests/utils.py) to prepend the default scheme before parsing scheme-less URLs and preserve `auth` credentials in the reconstructed network location (`netloc`).
- Updated [`get_auth_from_url`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-80sb6p1p/requests/utils.py#L988-L1002) in [`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-80sb6p1p/requests/utils.py) to safely default `None` username/password values to empty strings before unquoting.
- Updated [`rebuild_proxies`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-80sb6p1p/requests/sessions.py#L285-L300) in [`requests/sessions.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-80sb6p1p/requests/sessions.py) to ensure `Proxy-Authorization` headers are set whenever a username is present.
